# ataila_ai_model_launch_catalog (Data Source)

The launch catalogue (AI Center, read-only): the models each node can launch. The load and unload commands are never returned.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ataila_ai_model_launch_catalog" "enabled" {
  enabled = true
}

output "launchable" {
  value = [for e in data.ataila_ai_model_launch_catalog.enabled.entries : "${e.host}: ${e.model}"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Only enabled (or disabled) entries.
- `host` (String) Only the entries of this host.

### Read-Only

- `entries` (List of Object) The entries, by key: `key`, `host`, `label`, `model`, `engine`, `port`, `enabled`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entries))

<a id="nestedatt--entries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entries`

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `engine` (String)
- `host` (String)
- `key` (String)
- `label` (String)
- `model` (String)
- `port` (Number)
